description: dryvist/.github shareable Renovate preset — the org-wide entry point every dryvist repo inherits via `extends: ["local>dryvist/.github"]` (or `github>dryvist/.github`). Renovate resolves a bare repo reference to this `default.json`, so a one-line consumer gets config:recommended plus the JacobPEvans/.github master policy. This file exists so consumers no longer hit the deprecated `renovate.json`-as-preset fallback.

dryvist/.github holds no policy of its own: renovate-presets.json, renovate-grouping.json and renovate-nix.json pass through to JacobPEvans/.github. This repo's OWN self-config lives in renovate.json (which consumes this file). Nix repos extend the renovate-nix.json variant to opt in to Renovate's native nix manager.
